text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though today is usually my day off, I have
been summoned by the
empress. I make
my way over to our meeting spot.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You've got quite the nerve to keep me
waiting, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You didn't know about it? It's official
academy property, and we even
utilize it
for some classes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I called you out here to help me
move these.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following her gaze, I see a number of
wooden carts filled with
flowers. Red,
white, yellow... it certainly makes for a
colorful sight.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We have more blooms than anticipated.
This was not originally my
intention, but I
could use a hand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you've got time for jokes then you've
got time for work. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wow, they're all so lovely! Thank you for
doing this every year, Air
Groove!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We park the carts in front of the
dormitories, where we're met with a
long
line of students.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
One flower per person. Stay in line, and
tell us which color you desire
when it's
your turn.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to deliver them in person if you
can, preferably with a
letter or gift. That's
the best way to show your appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Mom's definitely going to love this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suddenly remember what day it is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I always plant them so that
they'll bloom around this
time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Many of us are living far away from our
parents currently. At times like
these, it's
more important than ever to show our
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Incidentally, do you know what a yellow
carnation signifies?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Do I have to explain everything?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
First,
take the red carnation. It signifies
love for one's mother. It
makes for a very
popular gift on this day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, a yellow carnation
signifies jealousy, and is often
avoided as a
gift.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You may be surprised to hear that there
are a number of students who
choose the
yellow carnations.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Many of them are second-generation
runners, and it is no stretch to say that
they see their own mothers as their
biggest
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In other words, giving your mother a
yellow carnation is akin to saying
that you
will surpass her legacy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All right,
that was the last student. Thank
you for your help.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It looks like we only have a single yellow
carnation remaining.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove smiles gently as her eyes fall
onto the remaining blossom.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I'll give this one to my own
mother.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as Air Groove is about to take the
flower into her own hands, we
hear a pair
of footsteps hesitantly approaching.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: U-umm...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're from Ritto Dorm. Is something
the matter?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
I was doing some extra training today, and
before I knew it the sun
started setting.
Um... Are the flowers all gone?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No—in fact, you're quite lucky. There's
exactly one left.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Go on, it's yours.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The young girl bows her head in thanks to
Air Groove and promptly
departs.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... Just enough, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her visage is stoic with a hint of
satisfaction... but it's difficult to tell
what
she is really feeling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do know that she was planning on taking
that last flower, though. I
can't help but be
reminded of when she was injured at the
dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh. You're such a worrywart.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm not too proud about what happened at
that dance lesson, but I've
thought long
and hard about my attitude since then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I mean to earn the respect of others, I
need to respect myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's no good pursuing my ideals if I
neglect
my own needs in the
process. On that
point, I admit... I was a little foolish.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What just happened now is different,
though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I don't mind going without a
flower at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even without a tangible symbol to
represent it, the resolve in my
heart is firm.
I will tell my mother of my ambition
directly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. So there is nothing you need to
worry about.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I can't have any trainer of mine being too
flustered for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Although... I suppose if you hadn't spoken
up in the infirmary, I...
wouldn't have...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking better care of myself now,
that's
all!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My mother doesn't often reminisce about
her racing career, but I once
overheard her
say that she couldn't have become a
queen by herself...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That the watchful eyes of someone she
trusted became a mirror—one
which more
honestly reflected her ideal self.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What I'm trying to say is... well,
you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why do I get the sense that you're teasing
me? ...Fool.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a hint of kindness in her
halfhearted scolding. We pause
awhile to
watch the sun set.
